TimeWrapped не сохраняет текст окон, наж: TimeWrapped does not store window text, keystrokes, screenshots, messages or passwords. Core tracking stores the app name, category and time. Website history is collected by the browser companion only after you enable it; domains and time are saved by default. Optional music history also stores track titles and artists. Gaming extensions request your selected public profile from OpenDota and FACEIT; you can disable them under Extensions.
